# llms.txt — @fams/v5-composer export index (hand-authored — see
# packages/skeleton-kit/llms.txt's header for why). Every current barrel
# export symbol name (main barrel `src/index.ts` + secondary `src/fields/
# index.ts`, which the main barrel also re-exports) must appear somewhere
# below as a whole word; `pnpm build:llms -- --check` (wired into
# `pnpm lint`) enforces it.
# format: Symbol(s) :: purpose :: key signature/props :: file

InMemoryDataStore, joinRefCsv :: In-memory data store the composer runs against during demo/dev; `Persistence`/`FilterValue`/`AppliedFilters`/`ListQuery` are its read/filter contract. `joinRefCsv` formats a multi-ref field for CSV-style display. :: new InMemoryDataStore(records) :: src/store.ts
evalCondition, resolvePermissions, isTaskVisible, allowedTransitions :: Blueprint rule evaluation — field-visibility/permission conditions, task/tab visibility, and allowed pipeline-status transitions, all evaluated against a `UserContext` + record. :: evalCondition(condition: Condition, record, ctx: UserContext) → boolean :: src/rules.ts
evalRecordAutomations, RecordAutomation, RecordAutomationEffect :: The generic cross-module "when a column reaches a value, create a record in another module and reference it back" vocabulary (`UiConfig.recordAutomation`) — a PURE evaluator (no React, no I/O) that computes the intended `RecordAutomationEffect[]` from a record's previous value + an incoming patch; the consuming app performs the actual create/patch (e.g. the demo env's `composer-data.ts`). Mirrors `rules.ts`'s house style. :: evalRecordAutomations(automations: RecordAutomation[] | undefined, prev: EntityRecord, patch: Record<string, unknown>) → RecordAutomationEffect[] :: src/automation.ts
createAppRuntime :: Builds an `AppRuntime` (module registry + handle lookup) from a `Blueprint`'s `ModuleSpec[]`/`DataSourceBinding`s/`TenantBrand`, per `AppRuntimeOptions`. Types: `ModuleType`, `ViewKind`, `DataSourceBinding`, `CreateSpec`, `ModuleSpec`, `TenantBrand`, `Blueprint`, `AppRuntimeOptions`, `ModuleHandle`. :: createAppRuntime(blueprint: Blueprint, options: AppRuntimeOptions) → AppRuntime :: src/composition.ts
deriveColumns, deriveCard, deriveFilters, deriveDetail, buildEntityModuleData, buildPipelineModuleData, deriveSummaryTiles, SummaryTileModel :: Blueprint → view-config derivation — turns an `EntityConfig` into the `Column[]`/`Cell`/`CardModel`/`FilterFacet[]`/`DetailModel` a template renders, and assembles the full per-module-type data bag (`EntityModuleData`/`PipelineModuleData`, incl. `PipelineStage`/`MapZoneShape`). `deriveSummaryTiles` is the pure (no-React) half of `uiConfig.listSummary`'s derivation — counts records per tile filter into a `SummaryTileModel[]` (`{id, label, value, icon?, tone?, iconColor?, iconBg?}`) that `@fams/v5-templates` maps onto `ListView.summaryTiles`. :: buildEntityModuleData(config: EntityConfig, records) → EntityModuleData; deriveSummaryTiles(config, records) → SummaryTileModel[] :: src/config-render.ts
instantiateBlueprint, toEntityConfig :: Loads an authored `BlueprintJson`/`ModuleConfigJson` (a `BlueprintBundle`) and instantiates it into an `InstantiatedBlueprint`/`EntityConfig` per `InstantiateOptions`. :: instantiateBlueprint(bundle: BlueprintBundle, options?: InstantiateOptions) → InstantiatedBlueprint :: src/blueprint-loader.ts
FilterKind, FilterOptionsSource, FilterOption, FilterExpandColumn, FilterExpandView, FilterExpandRowTemplate, FilterRowTemplate, FilterRowBadgeTone, FilterCreateFromSearch, FilterOptionDot, FiltersPanelConfig :: `FilterDef` v2 — the metadata vocabulary of the V2 dynamic filter panel (FAMILY C, decision D-1). `FilterKind` replaces the old `control`+`multiple` pair (`single-select`/`multi-select`/`status`/`tags`/`entity`/`date`/`checkbox-group`); `FilterOptionsSource` names where a facet's options come from (`listValues`/`statusList`/`records`/`inline`) and `FilterOption` is one resolved option (`{value, label, category?, color?, count?, meta?}` — `color` carried from `StatusDef.chipColor ?? .color`, structurally identical to `@fams/ui-kit`'s `ComboOption` so no adapter is needed across the layer boundary). `FilterExpandView`/`FilterExpandColumn` configure an expandable entity selector's side-sheet table and `FilterExpandRowTemplate`/`FilterRowTemplate`/`FilterRowBadgeTone` its RICH row (R-38/DN-30: `{avatar?, title, subtitle?, idPill?, statusBadge?: {col, colors?}}` — column names only, each element omitted when the host cannot resolve its column; the legacy `'plain'`/`'avatar-id-status'` shorthands still resolve), `FilterCreateFromSearch` its privilege-gated create-from-search CTA, `FilterOptionDot` the option row's colour dot source, and `FiltersPanelConfig` the panel chrome (`uiConfig.filtersPanel`). All additive — the legacy flat `FilterDef` shape stays valid. :: (types only — resolved by `deriveFilters()` into `FilterFacet`) :: src/types.ts
FieldType, ReferenceKind, SystemColumn, StatusDef, FieldPlacement, ProfileSection, FilterDef, ProfileTab, UiConfig, EntityConfig, EntityRecord, Condition, PipelineRules, ResolvedPermissions, UserContext :: The core low-code data-shape vocabulary every other module in this package operates on — an entity's field/column/filter/profile-tab config, its live record shape, and the requesting user's context. :: EntityConfig { fields, columns, filters, profile, … } :: src/types.ts
getModuleType, registerModuleType, listModuleTypes, resolveModuleViews, resolveModuleViewSpecs, viewSpecKind, viewLabel, viewLabelIn :: The module-type registry — `entity`/`pipeline`/etc. register their `ModuleTemplateRefs`/`ModuleTypeDef` here; `resolveModuleViews` turns a module type into its available view kinds (`ViewKind[]`), `resolveModuleViewSpecs` into fully-labelled `ResolvedView[]` (a blueprint entry may be a bare kind or a `ViewSpec`/`ViewSpecObject` `{ kind, label?, icon? }`, whose `label` names the module's own lens — e.g. the operations-center consoles: `dispatcher-cockpit`/`triage-console`/`fleet-console`/`workforce-pulse`); `viewSpecKind` reduces either form to its kind. :: registerModuleType(def: ModuleTypeDef) :: src/module-registry.ts
FieldComponentRef, AuthoredSystemColumn, AuthoredFieldPlacement, AuthoredStatusDef, AuthoredFilterDef, AuthoredProfileSection, AuthoredProfileTab, AuthoredUiConfig, EntityModuleConfigBlueprint, PipelineModuleConfigBlueprint, InboxModuleConfigBlueprint, ModuleCreateSpec, ModuleBlueprint, BlueprintBrand, BlueprintDoc :: The AUTHORED-JSON shape of a blueprint (as it lives in `blueprints/*/*.json`, before `instantiateBlueprint` resolves it) — mirrors `types.ts` one level up, JSON-Schema-validated (`schemas/*.json`). :: (types only — see schemas/*.json) :: src/blueprint-schema.ts
DashboardColorIndex, DashboardColorToken, DashboardDimensionValues, DashboardSourceVariant, DashboardMedia, DashboardWidgetType, DashboardSeries, DashboardSlice, DashboardBreakdownTone, DashboardStatTileTone, DashboardStatTile, DashboardSeverity, DashboardMetaItem, DashboardListItem, DashboardRow, DashboardColumn, DashboardCounterKey, DashboardScopeFilter, DashboardListRail, DashboardHeatCell, DashboardBin, DashboardLegendEntry, DashboardGaugeSector, DashboardCenterLabel, DashboardAxisSpec, DashboardWidgetDataSource, DashboardWidget, DashboardKpiTile, DashboardFilterPill, DashboardSavedView, DashboardModuleConfigBlueprint, DASHBOARD_WIDGET_TYPES, DASHBOARD_KPI_TYPES, DASHBOARD_FILTER_PILL_TYPES :: The AUTHORED-JSON shape of a DASHBOARD module config (`schemas/DashboardModuleConfig.schema.json`) — a `kpiStrip` + `filterPills` + a 12-column `widgetGrid` of 16 widget forms (15 data widgets — including `breakdown-strip` (the Figma "Progress Overview" stat-row + overlapping proportion bar over `slices[]` with a semantic `DashboardBreakdownTone`) and `stat-tile-group` (a titled panel of accent-topped `DashboardStatTile`s — label/value/caption/`DashboardStatTileTone`/icon — the Deployment headcount breakdown, also the `kpiStripVariant: "accent"` KPI row) plus `stack`, a layout node whose `children` share one grid cell — the Figma masonry column `span` alone cannot express), all bound through ONE shared `DashboardWidgetDataSource` vocabulary (static series/items/rows/cells, or a `kind: 'module'` declaration a consuming app resolves). Rendered by `@fams/v5-templates`' `DashboardGrid` template. `DashboardScopeFilter` is a select scoped to ONE widget (rendered in its card header, not the page toolbar); `DashboardListRail` turns a map widget into map + searchable event rail; `DashboardCounterKey` keys one position of a `render: 'counters'` cell; `DashboardColorToken` binds a series/slice/counter/legend entry to a NON-categorical token (`var(--color-primary)`, a semantic status hue) when the 5-slot categorical palette is the wrong vocabulary; `DashboardMedia` is the JSON-expressible leading visual of a leaderboard row (avatar or tinted glyph); `DashboardDimensionValues` is the declarative link between a header filter pill and the data it filters — a pill states the DIMENSION it drives (`DashboardFilterPill.dimension`) and every filterable datum (series, slice, item, row, cell, and each category position via `dataSource.categoryDimensions`) states the dimension values it belongs to, with omission meaning "not scoped by it" rather than "excluded"; `DashboardSourceVariant` is its scalar counterpart (`dataSource.variants`), a whole-source override applied under one combination of filter values for a widget whose datum IS the widget (a gauge, a KPI card, a donut centre). :: (types only — see schemas/DashboardModuleConfig.schema.json) :: src/blueprint-schema.dashboard.ts
validateBlueprint, validateEntityModuleConfig, validatePipelineModuleConfig, validateDashboardModuleConfig :: JSON-Schema validation of an authored blueprint/module-config, returning a `ValidationResult` (`ValidationError[]` on failure) — the loud-failure gate before `instantiateBlueprint` ever runs. :: validateBlueprint(doc: BlueprintDoc) → ValidationResult :: src/validate.ts
compileFieldSet, clearCompileCache, getCompileCacheStats, defaultFieldRegistry, registerFieldType, resetFieldRegistry, getFieldTypeEntry, getReadRenderer, getEditWidget, getCellEditor, listRegisteredFieldTypes, registerComponent, getComponentRenderer, SchemaForm, SchemaFormField, useSchemaForm, mapSchemaFormOut :: The field-type compiler + registry + `SchemaForm` (react-hook-form + zod, decision-line: v5-composer adopted these in phase 2 §2). `compileFieldSet` turns a `FieldSetInput` into a memoized `CompiledFieldSet` (`LayoutRow`/`LayoutGroup`/`LayoutPlan`, one `FieldDescriptor` per field); the registry maps a `FieldTypeKey` to a `FieldTypeEntry` bundling its `ReadRenderer` (props `ReadRendererProps`), `EditWidget` (props `EditWidgetProps`), and `CellEditor` (props `CellEditorProps`), resolved per-field via `FieldOptionContext`. A second, NAMED-component registry — `registerComponent(name, read)`/`getComponentRenderer(name)` — resolves a `FieldDescriptor.component.name` override (e.g. `IconTextView`) independent of the field's TYPE, consulted first by `renderCellValue` before falling back to the type-keyed renderer. `SchemaForm`'s props are `SchemaFormProps`/`SchemaFormFieldProps`. Re-exported from the main barrel; canonical source is `src/fields/index.ts` (compiler.ts, types.ts, registry.tsx, SchemaForm.tsx). :: compileFieldSet(input: FieldSetInput, options?: CompileOptions) → CompiledFieldSet; useSchemaForm(options: UseSchemaFormOptions) → UseSchemaFormResult :: src/fields/index.ts
registerEditWidget, getEditWidgetOverride, resetEditWidgetRegistry, FieldChrome :: The EDIT-side sibling of the named component registry above — resolves `FieldDescriptor.component.name` to a per-field `EditWidget` override for `SchemaForm`'s write path (starts empty; `@fams/v5-templates` registers concrete widgets like `IconSelect`/`PhoneInput` as a side effect of importing `CreationSheet`). `FieldChrome` (`'default' | 'inset-label'`) is the field-shell opt-in a placement's `chrome` prop selects between (`'inset-label'` renders through `@fams/ui-kit`'s `InsetField`). :: registerEditWidget(name: string, widget: EditWidget): void :: src/fields/registry.tsx, src/fields/types.ts
DisplayNameProvider, useDisplayName, DisplayNameResolver, DisplayNameProviderProps :: The ONE id→display-name seam for identity field renderers. An `Assignee` field stores a user id (`u_dispatcher`) and a `SingleReference` identity field stores a record id; both land in `ReadAssignee`/`ReadPersonView`, which are resolved from the registry by name and therefore have no prop chain to thread a resolver through. Wrap a module surface in `DisplayNameProvider resolve={(id) => name | undefined}` (a `DisplayNameResolver`) and every such cell — list column, detail row, kanban card footer — renders the name; `useDisplayName()` is the hook a custom renderer uses, and it falls back to the raw id when there is no provider or the id is unknown, so a pure presenter never owns a directory (Rule 8). :: useDisplayName() → (id: string) => string :: src/fields/display-names.tsx
LinkedRecordProvider, useLinkedRecordOpener, LinkedRecordTarget, LinkedRecordOpener, LinkedRecordProviderProps :: The ONE "open a linked record" seam, the activation sibling of `DisplayNameProvider`. A reference field stores an `entityType` + id; nothing in this package can know which module owns that entity code, which detail flavor it opens in, or how to read the row (Rule 8), so a host wraps its surface in `LinkedRecordProvider onOpenLinkedRecord={(target: LinkedRecordTarget) => …}` and every `LinkView`-authored reference cell below it becomes activatable at once — list column, kanban card, detail row, and rows inside an already-open side sheet. `useLinkedRecordOpener()` returns `undefined` with no provider, which is a renderer's cue to present the value inertly, exactly as before the seam existed. :: useLinkedRecordOpener() → ((target) => void) | undefined :: src/fields/linked-records.tsx
FIELD_ICON_VOCABULARY, FIELD_ICON_NAMES, resolveFieldIcon :: The ONE closed named-icon vocabulary every icon-bearing read renderer resolves through (`IconTextView`'s `props.icon`, `ActivityOverviewView`'s pairs) — Figma/untitled-ui layer names (`user-03`, `marker-pin-02`, `speedometer-04`, `alert-square`, `share-04`, `x-close`, `mark`, `route`, …) mapped onto their closest `lucide-react` glyph, since adding an icon package is banned. `resolveFieldIcon` returns `undefined` for an unknown name (callers render text with no icon rather than throwing); `FIELD_ICON_NAMES` is the key list a table-driven test iterates so a dropped mapping fails loudly instead of shipping an icon-less cell. :: resolveFieldIcon(name: string | undefined) → LucideIcon | undefined :: src/fields/renderers.tsx
resolveDefaultFieldIcon :: The EDIT-side sibling of `resolveFieldIcon` above — the platform field-states spec's "leading icon is dynamic, varies by field/data type" default (person for `Assignee`/a `Users`-domain reference, calendar for `Date`/`DateTime`, a link mark for `SingleReference`/`MultiReference`, …), used by every inset-chrome edit widget (`widgets.tsx`'s `insetWrap`) as the fallback when a field carries no explicit `component.props.icon` override (which still wins, resolved through `FIELD_ICON_VOCABULARY`). `undefined` for a type with no default and no override. :: resolveDefaultFieldIcon(descriptor: { type: FieldType; refModule?: string; component?: { props?: Record<string, unknown> } }) → FieldIconComponent | undefined :: src/fields/renderers.tsx
formatFigmaDate :: The ONE date/date-time display format for the composer family — `20 Feb, 2026` / `20 Feb, 2026 13:00` (day, short month, comma, year, 24h `HH:mm`). Deliberately NOT `toLocaleString()`, whose 12h/seconds/locale drift is what made card dates diverge from Figma; only the month abbreviation is `en-US`. Exported so a consumer outside the field registry (`@fams/v5-templates`' `RecordTable`, whose `datetime` columns printed stored ISO values verbatim) formats dates identically instead of growing a second implementation. :: formatFigmaDate(d: Date, withTime: boolean) → string :: src/fields/renderers.tsx
humanizeEnumValue :: Machine enum token → human label, for DISPLAY only — `jobOrderCreated` → "Job Order Created", `reported-issues` → "Reported Issues". A blueprint's `listValues` are storage keys and a read renderer never sees the pipeline's `uiConfig.statusList`, so raw keys reached users wherever no label map was supplied. Deliberately narrow: fires only on an unambiguously machine-authored token (no whitespace; camelCase or `-`/`_` separated, no uppercase outside a camel hump), so `CNG`, `hazmat`, `Brake Inspection` and `Non-Compliant` pass through untouched. Idempotent. :: humanizeEnumValue(raw: string) → string :: src/fields/renderers.tsx
computeThresholdTone :: The ONE progress-meter threshold-tone computation — `ReadProgressMeter`'s fill tone when a placement omits an explicit `tone`: `>=100%` of target → `danger`, `>=80%` → `warning`, else `success` (no target → the raw value read as a 0-100 percentage). Exported so a consumer outside the field registry (`@fams/v5-templates`' `RecordTable`, whose `progress` column used to fall through to `TableCell`'s fixed `primary` default) computes the identical tone instead of growing a second implementation (fix7 wave 6, P1). :: computeThresholdTone(value: number | undefined, target: number | undefined) → StatBarTone :: src/fields/renderers.tsx
composeModule, ComposedModule, resolvePrimaryTemplateRef :: The one low-code entry point — `composeModule`/`<ComposedModule/>` render any blueprint through a `RendererRegistry` (`ModuleRenderer` per view kind) via a `DataAdapter`, falling back from `LowCodeModuleProps` to `BespokeModuleProps` (the escape hatch) per `resolvePrimaryTemplateRef`. `ModuleRenderContext`/`ComposedModuleProps` round out the renderer contract. :: <ComposedModule {...composedModuleProps} /> :: src/composer.tsx
ModuleAlertBar :: The composer-side implementation of `uiConfig.alertBar` — a soft-tinted strip pinned above a module's filters row ("N employees are absent — dispatch a reliever now") plus the side sheet it opens on click. :: alertBar config from the blueprint's `uiConfig` :: src/fields/ModuleAlertBar.tsx
